instruction: Fix `DocumentStore.delete` in `datastore/store.py` so it returns `False` when the key was not present. It currently reports `True` even when nothing was removed, so callers cannot tell whether a delete actually happened.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/datastore/store.py b/datastore/store.py
--- a/datastore/store.py
+++ b/datastore/store.py
@@ -33,7 +33,8 @@
         """Remove ``key``; return ``True`` if it was present, else ``False``."""
         if key in self._docs:
             del self._docs[key]
-        return True
+            return True
+        return False
 
     def __contains__(self, key) -> bool:
         return key in self._docs
